blocks.lede: Creating the outdoor living space of your dreams has never been easier than working with Island Life Custom Pools. We are a custom pool designer & installer serving Tomball TX, Cypress, The Woodlands, TX and Houston TX, helping clients with installing amazing custom swimming pools, custom patios, and outdoor kitchens perfect for entertainment and relaxation. When you work with Island Life Custom Pools, we will create a space that feels like your own little island in your backyard.

blocks.title: Experience the ultimate
blocks.imageAlt: Covered pavilion with a stone fireplace across a dark pool at dusk
blocks.text: Here at Island Life Custom Pools, we long to give people a place in their backyard where they can escape from the stress of their day-to-day lives. We do this by installing spectacular backyard pools, patios, and outdoor kitchens that will transport you to your island paradise. When you hire our team, we’ll work closely with you to capture your vision and dream for your pool and create a personalized design just for you.

blocks.label: Five-star backyard experiences
blocks.title:
Hear what our clients
have to say.

reviews.name: Jeff L.
reviews.quote: Having recently moved to a new area, we relied on a friend who highly recommended Island Life Custom Pools. We are so glad that we heeded their advice. Tim exceeded our expectations with the construction of our beautiful pool. He was extremely communicative, detail oriented and surrounded himself with quality subs. In addition, his passion for assisting us with aesthetics was greatly appreciated. In essence, we would highly recommend Tim and his team to create your own slice of paradise.

reviews.name: Sam M.
reviews.quote: We had an amazing experience with Island Life custom pools. Tim and team took amazing care in helping us develop and execute on our vision. We really wanted to build a pool and an outdoor space we could use year round to bring people together. The quality and craftsmanship of the final product exceed our expectations and we came in on time and on budget. I think what sets Tim apart as a builder is his superb communication skills. We were always given a thorough understanding each step of the way from design, to excavation, to the structure and fireplace, all the way to start up! The crews are top notch and all materials feel premium I would highly recommend Island Life Custom Pools.

reviews.name: Jasmine H.
reviews.quote: We had a wonderful experience using Island Life to build our pool, spa and fire pit. Tim and Jose were in constant communication with us with a weekly calendar to keep us updated every step of the way. Even the construction crews were very nice and polite. We are so impressed with how everything turned out. It is so beautiful and we are so happy with it. We highly recommend.

reviews.name: Annette
reviews.quote: Huge thanks to Island Life Custom Pools for converting our backyard into our own personal oasis. Tim (the owner) made the process very easy and stress free. He is an honest man who constantly kept his word and heard our every want/must haves and made it happen. Tim is very responsive and answered all calls and text fast. He knew how our dogs are spoiled and even made a cute trail for them! If you don’t know anything about pools, don’t worry, he walks you through every step of the way. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Dee G.
reviews.quote: From the design to close-out, Tim and Eric were amazing! They addressed any issue big or small, listened to our needs and concerns and started working on them immediately. Our pool is beautiful. Making a large purchase like this can be a stressful time but Tim was patient and Eric new exactly what we wanted. We are so happy we chose Island Life Pools!!
